story_title: The whole country, on your schedule
story: The trips that matter most to Mexican families and companies often point north. A specialist at the Texas Medical Center. A board meeting in Midtown. A long weekend in South Beach, or a studio visit in the San Fernando Valley. On an airline, each of those days often starts with fixed departure times, a crowded customs hall and a wait at the carousel. On a private jet from Mexico to USA cities, it starts at a quiet terminal in Toluca, 65 km west of the capital.

JETCAB flies to any airport in the continental United States with private handling, and takes care of the parts most travelers never see: the eAPIS manifest filed about 24 hours before departure, the arrival with US Customs and Border Protection, and handling at the private terminal on landing. The Learjet 35 seats up to 7, the Challenger 605 up to 12 in a stand-up cabin and the Gulfstream GV up to 16. You choose the city and the hour.
why_title: Why book a private jet from Mexico to USA with JETCAB

why.d: JETCAB files the eAPIS manifest with US Customs and Border Protection and coordinates your arrival with the private terminal. On landing, officers clear your party apart from the commercial crowds, usually in minutes, and your driver is waiting a few steps from the aircraft.

Opa-locka Executive is 20 minutes from South Beach. Hobby is 10 minutes from Downtown Houston. Van Nuys is 15 minutes from Beverly Hills, and Teterboro about 20 minutes from Midtown Manhattan. Each one keeps you away from the big commercial terminals.

Every fare covers the whole jet with crew, fuel, catering and permits. On a Learjet 35 for up to 7 passengers, Houston starts at $3,800 USD, Miami at $4,800, Los Angeles at $5,200 and New York at $9,500, one way.

The Learjet 35 seats up to 7 for quick business trips. The Challenger 605 carries up to 12 with a stand-up cabin, and the Gulfstream GV takes up to 16 with the range for longer coast-to-coast itineraries. Each is quoted on WhatsApp in 30 minutes.

journey_title: A typical day flying to Houston

journey.d: Your driver collects you early for the 45 to 60 minute drive west to Toluca. To save time, the JETCAB helicopter transfer from Polanco, Lomas, Santa Fe or Reforma covers the same distance in about 25 minutes.

Car to aircraft steps in under 10 minutes. Your passport and visa details went into the eAPIS manifest the day before, so there is no counter and no form to fill out. Bags are loaded while you take your seat.

Wheels up toward the border. Breakfast is served while the cabin settles into whatever you need: a briefing with your team, a quiet call or sleep. On the Houston route you have about 2 hours 45 minutes in the air.

You touch down at William P. Hobby Airport around 11:00 am Central time in winter. US Customs clears your group at the airport, coordinated in advance, and your car is waiting outside the private terminal.

Downtown Houston is about 10 minutes away and the Texas Medical Center a short drive further. Keep the afternoon for your appointment or meeting and, if you plan it that way, fly home to Toluca the same evening.

best_time_title: When to book your US flight
best_time: Plan around each city's calendar. Miami is at its best from November to April, and early December brings Art Basel Miami Beach, when private terminals and hotels fill quickly. New York shines in spring and fall, with the holiday windows of December close behind. Houston and McAllen are easiest outside the hottest summer months, and Los Angeles is pleasant nearly all year. For every US route, allow about 24 hours so JETCAB can file the eAPIS manifest. For Art Basel, Thanksgiving, Christmas and spring break, request your quote well ahead of time.
airport: In the United States, private flights land at airports with dedicated private terminals, known as FBOs, and international arrivals clear US Customs and Border Protection at an airport with a customs facility, which JETCAB plans into the route. Common arrivals include Miami-Opa Locka Executive (OPF), Houston Hobby (HOU), Van Nuys (VNY) for Los Angeles and Teterboro (TEB) for New York, along with private terminals in Dallas, Chicago and Phoenix. Before departure JETCAB files eAPIS, books the customs arrival and arranges handling, so you walk from the aircraft to your car.
docs_title: Documents for a private jet from Mexico to USA
docs: Mexican citizens need a valid passport and a valid US visa. US citizens travel on their passport, and permanent residents on their green card. Other nationalities should confirm their entry requirements before booking, since some visa waiver rules work differently on private aircraft. JETCAB files the eAPIS manifest with US Customs about 24 hours before departure, so send each passenger's full name, date of birth, nationality and passport number when you book. Minors need their own passports.

faq.q: Can JETCAB fly from Mexico to any city in the United States?
faq.a: Yes. JETCAB flies to any airport in the continental United States with private handling, from Miami, Houston and Dallas to Los Angeles, Chicago and New York. The route, any fuel stop and the customs arrival point are planned into your quote, which is confirmed on WhatsApp in 30 minutes.

faq.q: How much does a private jet from Mexico to USA cost?
faq.a: On a Learjet 35 for up to 7 passengers, one way per aircraft: Houston from $3,800 USD, Miami from $4,800, Los Angeles from $5,200 and New York from $9,500. The Challenger 605 and Gulfstream GV cost more. Crew, fuel, catering and permits are always included.

faq.q: Do you go through TSA when flying private?
faq.a: You skip the commercial security lines. At the Toluca private terminal your car reaches the aircraft steps in under 10 minutes. On arrival in the United States, you clear Customs and Border Protection like every international traveler, only with your own group at a private facility.

faq.q: How far in advance should I book a private jet to the US?
faq.a: About 24 hours ahead, because JETCAB files the eAPIS passenger manifest with US Customs before departure. Urgent same-day trips can sometimes be arranged, so ask on WhatsApp. For peak dates such as Art Basel, Thanksgiving and Christmas, book earlier to secure the aircraft you want.

faq.q: Do you tip a private jet pilot?
faq.a: Tipping is not required, and no gratuity is ever added to a JETCAB quote since the price already covers the crew. If a pilot or flight attendant went out of their way for you, a tip is a personal gesture you are free to make or skip.

faq.q: What is the cheapest way to fly privately to the US?
faq.a: Choose the right aircraft and fill it. The Learjet 35, for up to 7 passengers, is the most economical cabin, starting at $3,800 USD one way to Houston. Because the price is per aircraft, each extra passenger lowers the cost per person. Flexible dates can also match you with an empty leg.
